prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:

No clear effect was seen across multiple tests for home notifications, sign-in copy, choose_path copy, home wait info, and adoption redesigns.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Launcher Kickoff Screen: Introduce a dedicated launchpad screen right before home intro that verifies window overlay permissions and triggers the pet spawn animation. (why: Support mail indicates 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to open, causing drop-offs at the finish step (64.8%).)
1: [home, wait_info] Real-Time Pet Behavior Assembly Status: Display explicit background assembly steps and live progress indicators on the waiting screen during initial load. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s) and median of 201s. Transparent behavior assembly info reassures waiting users.)
2: [adoption, copy] Instant Generation Guarantee Copy: Update adoption certificate copy to clarify that custom companion generation includes automatic instant fallback rendering if photo synthesis encounters an error. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or visual bugs, leading to adoption drop-offs.)
3: [finish, notification] First Desktop Spawn Audio Bell Signal: Add an audio ready notification and chime trigger to home_intro that alerts users when their desktop pet has completed rendering. (why: Helps users who minimized the app during long home wait times (201s median) notice that their pet is active.)
